finding: A clearly verified treatment variable has not yet been established
redemption_status is a candidate observed outcome
Available identifier and campaign relationships do not establish assignment
Demographic variables are potential covariates; timing and relevance require validation
Transaction variables require validation of meaning and timing relative to treatment
Campaign and transaction dates must be interpreted and aligned correctly
A defensible assignment mechanism and identification assumptions have not been established
Causal effect estimation should wait until treatment and identification are justified
